svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Component · PicPlace status · working-copy · phone
svg.desc: Mirrors PicPlaceStatusCard (App/PicPlace/PicPlaceViews.swift) in its .previewOnly state with the project's full-size working copy here (picture tiers stage 5, 2026-10-04; docs/picture-tiers-plan.md §15): the originals are on PicPlace, not on this device — free up space removed them, or the project was pulled as a preview — and the working copy (picture-<token>.heic, the grade in its pixels) was fetched or left behind, so text, masks, shapes, the crop and the level work on it without the originals. The glyph is the green photo.fill (#248A3D on a light card: here; StatusGlyph.Asset.workingCopy), the title "Working copy here" (title(for:) when shownHoldings.hasWorkingCopy), the caption "The originals are on PicPlace · 1 file · 2,9 MB" (caption(for:), lineLimit 2 beside the 116 pt action), the action "Download originals" as on the preview-only card. Under the divider at 66 the Working copy line (heavyLines: first, before any Blends line; HeavyLine.Action.removeWorkingCopy): title "Working copy", detail "Here · 1,3 MB · text, masks, shapes and crop work on it" (holdings.workingCopyBytes), the button "Remove…" (disabled while a free-up run is on) — its confirm "Remove the working copy from this iPhone?" / Remove Working Copy / "1,3 MB. PicPlace keeps the working copy — it comes down again when you open the project to edit text, masks, shapes or crop. Until then the project shows its preview." (removalMessage(.workingCopy)). Then the note (notes(for:), when no removal note is pending): "The working copy comes back from PicPlace when you open the project to edit it." After the Remove the card is picplace-status.preview-only (no line, the Download originals offer). A photo capture draws no Blends line; an interval with blends on PicPlace adds one after this line. Demo data: the 2026-10-04 bench's JPEG (2,9 MB original, 1,3 MB working copy).

g.text: Here · 1,3 MB · text, masks, shapes and crop work on it
The working copy comes back from PicPlace when you open the project to edit it.
